sloka: स्त्वैः पक्षैः पवन उद्धूतैः गवाक्षैः स्फाटिकैः इव ।शिखिनीभिः परिवृतास्त एते मद मूर्छिताः ॥४-१-३७॥
transliteration: stvaiḥ pakṣaiḥ pavana uddhūtaiḥ gavākṣaiḥ sphāṭikaiḥ iva ।śikhinībhiḥ parivṛtāsta ete mada mūrchitāḥ ॥4-1-37॥

translations.english: 'The peacocks intoxicated with passion for the peahens surround them intensifying my longing (for Vaidehi).
